run_melanoma_handler: run the melanoma_handler function to import the ISBI-ISIC 2017 melanoma classification dataset with metadata and generators
create_path_label_pairs: create path label pairs by reading a CSV ground truth file and mapping image IDs to class labels
parse_image_label_line: parse a CSV line to extract an image path and its melanoma or seborrheic keratosis label
get_zip_label_paths: get the zip data file and label CSV file paths for a given train dev or test split
configure_downloadable_dataset: configure a DownloadableDataset with download URLs, checksums, and the melanoma handler for the ISIC 2017 challenge
